options.name: activation_keys
options.description: Activation Keys used for deployment. Comma separated list. Only available for Katello installations.

options.name: architecture
options.description: Architecture name

options.name: build
options.description: Whether or not to setup build context for the host

options.name: ca_path
options.description: PEM formatted file that contains a CA certificate to be used for validation. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_CA_PATH) will be used instead.

options.name: comment
options.description: Comment about the host.

options.name: compute_attributes
options.description: Additional compute resource specific attributes. When this parameter is set, the module will not be idempotent. When you provide a I(cluster) here and I(compute_resource) is set, the cluster id will be automatically looked up.

options.name: compute_profile
options.description: Compute profile name

options.name: compute_resource
options.description: Compute resource name

options.name: config_groups
options.description: Config groups list

options.name: content_source
options.description: Content Source (Smart Proxy with Content) name. Only available for Katello installations.

options.name: content_view
options.description: Content view. Only available for Katello installations.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain name

options.name: enabled
options.description: Include this host within reporting

options.name: environment
options.description: Puppet environment name

options.name: hostgroup
options.description: Title of related hostgroup Example: A child hostgroup I(bar) within a parent hostgroup I(foo) would have the title I(foo/bar).

options.name: image
options.description: The image to use when I(provision_method=image). The I(compute_resource) parameter is required to find the correct image.

options.name: interfaces_attributes
options.description: Additional interfaces specific attributes.

options.name: ip
options.description: IP address of the primary interface of the host.

options.name: kickstart_repository
options.description: Kickstart repository name. You need to provide this to use the "Synced Content" feature. Mutually exclusive with I(medium). Only available for Katello installations.

options.name: lifecycle_environment
options.description: Lifecycle environment. Only available for Katello installations.

options.name: location
options.description: Name of related location

options.name: mac
options.description: MAC address of the primary interface of the host. Please include leading zeros and separate nibbles by colons, otherwise the execution will not be idempotent. Example EE:BB:01:02:03:04

options.name: managed
options.description: Whether a host is managed or unmanaged. Forced to true when I(build=true)

options.name: medium
options.description: Medium name Mutually exclusive with I(kickstart_repository).

options.name: name
options.description: Fully Qualified Domain Name of host

options.name: oauth1_consumer_key
options.description: OAuth1 consumer key for accessing the Foreman server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_OAUTH1_CONSUMER_KEY) will be used instead.

options.name: oauth1_consumer_secret
options.description: OAuth1 consumer secret for accessing the Foreman server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_OAUTH1_CONSUMER_SECRET) will be used instead.

options.name: openscap_proxy
options.description: OpenSCAP proxy name. Only available when the OpenSCAP plugin is installed.

options.name: operatingsystem
options.description: Operating systems are looked up by their title which is composed as "<name> <major>.<minor>". You can omit the version part as long as you only have one operating system by that name.

options.name: organization
options.description: Name of related organization

options.name: owner
options.description: Owner (user) of the host. Users are looked up by their C(login). Mutually exclusive with I(owner_group).

options.name: owner_group
options.description: Owner (user group) of the host. Mutually exclusive with I(owner).

options.name: parameters
options.description: Entity domain specific host parameters

options.name: password
options.description: Password of the user accessing the Foreman server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: provision_method
options.description: The method used to provision the host. I(provision_method=bootdisk) is only available if the bootdisk plugin is installed.

options.name: ptable
options.description: Partition table name

options.name: puppet_ca_proxy
options.description: Puppet CA proxy name

options.name: puppet_proxy
options.description: Puppet server proxy name

options.name: puppetclasses
options.description: List of puppet classes to include in this host group. Must exist for hostgroup's puppet environment.

options.name: pxe_loader
options.description: PXE Bootloader

options.name: realm
options.description: Realm name

options.name: root_pass
options.description: Root password. Will result in the entity always being updated, as the current password cannot be retrieved.

options.name: server_url
options.description: URL of the Foreman server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_SERVER_URL) will be used instead.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the entity

options.name: subnet
options.description: IPv4 Subnet name

options.name: subnet6
options.description: IPv6 Subnet name

options.name: use_gssapi
options.description: Use GSSAPI to perform the authentication, typically this is for Kerberos or Kerberos through Negotiate authentication. Requires the Python library L(requests-gssapi,https://github.com/pythongssapi/requests-gssapi) to be installed. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_USE_GSSAPI) will be used instead.

options.name: username
options.description: Username accessing the Foreman server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_USERNAME) will be used instead.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether or not to verify the TLS certificates of the Foreman server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_VALIDATE_CERTS) will be used instead.
